Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

Routbreak 0.3.0

  • Added rob_table() for a single aligned community-level summary and as_rmatrix() for validated destination-row/source-column long data.
  • Added is_irreducible() and matrix_diagnostics() to expose strongly connected components and cyclic periods. Periodic continuation cases are reported rather than assigned a cycle-averaged value.
  • Replaced the dimension-dependent per-edge Gamma default with an explicit prior interface: infer_R() and infer_R_sufficient() now require users to supply scientifically justified prior_shape and prior_rate values.
  • Added infer_R() for generation-resolved directed transmission data and infer_R_sufficient() for precomputed transmission counts and source exposures.
  • Added explicit maximum-likelihood estimates, identification status, and proper shape-rate Gamma posterior moments for every transmission edge.
  • Added estimate_rob() to propagate posterior reproduction-matrix uncertainty to outbreak probabilities, outbreak reproduction ratios, and the reference reproduction ratio, with credible intervals and draw-failure diagnostics.
  • Added the “Estimating outbreak reproduction ratios from early transmission data” vignette and deterministic and seeded inference tests.
  • Improved near-threshold fixed-point convergence checks and prevented Gamma sampling underflow from creating artificial structural zeros.
  • Documented sensitivity of sparse estimates to independent-entry priors and distinguished independent-entry Gamma–Poisson inference from the unimplemented Canadian structured Stan model R = R_ref * M.
  • The inference likelihood remains Poisson-only. Negative-binomial zero-probability continuation and general reducible non-diagonal r_ob() calculations remain explicitly unsupported rather than silently approximated.

Routbreak 0.2.0

  • Added independent-edge negative-binomial offspring distributions to outbreak_prob() and r_ob() through the new offspring and omega arguments.
  • Implemented the negative-binomial fixed point from Eq. (5) and the outbreak reproduction ratio from Eq. (S4) of Wang and Valdano (2026).
  • Added deterministic, Poisson-limit, orientation, convergence, and seeded branching-process simulation tests.
  • Added the “Overdispersed offspring distributions” vignette.

Routbreak 0.1.0

  • Initial mathematical implementation for multitype Poisson branching processes.
  • Added outbreak, reference, local, and total reproduction ratios and matrix preparation helpers.
